title: Memory effect from the scattering of Taub-NUT black holes
summary: Taub-NUT black holes are somewhat exotic solutions to the vacuum Einstein equations, which have received limited attention in gravitational phenomenology. We use the soft behaviour of scattering amplitudes to compute the memory effect of the waveform resulting from the scattering of Kerr-Taub-NUT black holes. Due to the non-linear nature of gravity, NUT charges introduce intriguing features in the soft dynamics, which have no counterpart in the closely related setting of monopole charges in electromagnetism.
